items.label: Test standard
items.message: test record checked against ASTM D4018-23: 7 of 7 requirements the record shows are met; 10 clauses of the procedure are the laboratory's

requirements.text: A continuous-filament carbon or graphite yarn, roving or tow, impregnated with resin and consolidated before it is pulled.
requirements.limit: a continuous-filament carbon or graphite yarn, roving or tow

requirements.text: A gauge length of 150 mm ± 5 mm between the tabs, or between the grips of an untabbed specimen.
requirements.limit: 150 mm ± 5 mm between the tabs

requirements.text: At least four valid specimens tested for strength.
requirements.value: 4 valid specimens with a maximum force
requirements.limit: at least 4

requirements.text: At least four valid specimens tested for modulus, the same four as for strength or another four.
requirements.value: 4 valid specimens with both chord forces
requirements.limit: at least 4

requirements.text: Several fibre bundles combined into one specimen only for a tow of 3000 filaments or fewer, the bundles combined before impregnation.
requirements.limit: one bundle, or several combined only for a tow of 3000 filaments or fewer

requirements.text: A consolidated resin able to strain at least twice as far as the fibre.
requirements.limit: at least 2 times the fibre's, 42000 microstrain

requirements.text: The forces for the chord modulus read at the strains Table 2 gives for the product's typical strain at failure.
requirements.limit: 1000 microstrain to 6000 microstrain (Table 2, typical failure strain 21000 microstrain)

requirements.text: A mass-per-unit-length specimen of sized fibre at least 1 m long.
requirements.value: the mass per unit length is given, not the specimen it was weighed on
requirements.limit: at least 1 m

requirements.text: A testing machine speed of at most 250 mm/min.
requirements.limit: at most 250 mm/min

requirements.text: A uniform impregnation, typically 35 % to 60 % resin by weight.
requirements.limit: 35 % to 60 % by weight

requirements.text: The density measured on desized or unsized fibre.
requirements.limit: desized or unsized fibre

requirements.text: A sized fibre's density is corrected for its sizing by k_c, found from ten paired tests; no correction is needed when sized and desized results differ by less than 1.0 %.
requirements.limit: k_c from ten paired tests of sized and desized or unsized fibre; none needed when they differ by less than 1.0 %

requirements.text: Each specimen's failure recorded by its type, area and location.
requirements.limit: every specimen's failure coded by type, area and location (Fig. 1)

requirements.text: When a significant fraction of the failures lies within one specimen width of a tab or grip, re-examine the tabs, their adhesive, the grips, their pressure and their alignment.
requirements.value: 1 of 4 coded failures at, in or within one width of a tab or grip
requirements.limit: re-examine the tabs, the grips and their alignment when a significant fraction fails within one width of them

requirements.text: A testing machine verified to ASTM E4 at the largest expected force, its force recorded together with the extensometer's elongation.
An extensometer and recorder of ASTM E83 Class B-2.
Masses on an analytical balance to ±0.0002 g; lengths to ±2 mm.
The density by ASTM D3800 Method A (Archimedes) or by D70 or D5550 (pycnometer).
Conditioning and the test atmosphere by the fibre's moisture adsorption: no conditioning below 0.5 % by weight at 23 °C and 90 % relative humidity, 24 h at 23 °C and 50 % relative humidity above it.
The impregnated strand held under tension while it consolidates, and cured in an oven held within ±10 °C.
A preload no larger than Table 1 gives, found from the expected modulus and the fibre's area (the planning loads below).
The specimen centred in the jaws and aligned with the load.
Fuzzy, curved, uneven or otherwise flawed specimens rejected unless they represent the material.
A flawed or suspect specimen replaced or retested, slippage and breaks in the tabs or at the extensometer counted as such, every value recorded.

items.label: Results
items.message: 4 strengths and 4 moduli from the valid specimens

specimens.failure_words: grip or tab, at the grip or tab, top

result.note: Strength and chord modulus divide by the fibre's area, MUL / density (Eqs 4 and 5); the chord strains are absolute in the engine (ADR-0074: the standard's factor B gives GPa only with absolute strains). Nothing here is a model of the tow.
